Tech News Weekly: AI, Generative AI, XR, Robotics & Tech Policy Podcast | TWiT | TWiT.TV

Stay ahead in AI, generative AI, XR, robotics, social media & tech policy. Tech News Weekly with Mikah Sargent & top journalists delivers expert insights.

Actual Article Body:
Industry expert Mikah Sargent, brings you interviews from tech journalists who make or break the top stories of the week. Get the freshest perspective and in depth insight into the fast-paced world of technology from Tech News Weekly.

You can join Club TWiT for $10 per month and get ad-free audio and video feeds for all our shows plus everything else the club offers...or get just this podcast ad-free for $5 per month.

New episodes every Thursday.

E-mail us at tnw@twit.tv.

Join Club TWiT for Ad-Free Podcasts!Support what you love and get ad-free audio and video feeds, a members-only Discord, and exclusive content. Join Club TWiT today!

“As a tech journalist myself, this is the show I've always wanted to listen to. It’s a weekly conversation with the best reporters, researchers, creators, and more. I'm thrilled I get to be the one hosting it.”

Tech News Weekly with Mikah Sargent is where today's most important technology stories meet in-depth conversations with the experts shaping our digital future. Every week, Mikah sits down with leaders in AI, robotics, XR, smart home, social media, policy & regulation, and more, to deliver context, analysis, and perspective on current events.

Tackle AI regulation, the impact of generative AI on creativity, and the shifting landscape of tech policy and disinformation. Listeners also gain inside perspectives on major product launches, social media culture shifts, and the rapid evolution of smart home automation.

With Mikah’s sharp curiosity and trusted voice, Tech News Weekly isn’t just another tech podcast—it’s where you gain context, credibility, and clarity on the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you want authoritative, insightful, and up-to-the-minute tech coverage, Tech News Weekly is your must-listen podcast.

Mikah is joined by a rotating cast of top technology journalists from the industry’s most respected outlets—each bringing unique expertise and perspective:

Together, this lineup ensures Tech News Weekly delivers a comprehensive, authoritative, and future-focused view of technology that you won’t find anywhere else.

There are many ways to slice technology news. Enjoy more podcasts catering to the technology enthusiast from our network, TWiT.tv, dedicated to tech.

Best tech news podcast with Leo Laporte & top industry experts. Weekly coverage of AI breakthroughs, cutting-edge gadgets, Big Tech shakeups, cybersecurity threats, and future digital trends.

AI and emerging tech podcast hosted by Leo Laporte, Jeff Jarvis, & Paris Martineau. Exploring artificial intelligence, robotics, machine learning, and automation shaping the future of technology and society.

#1 cybersecurity and data protection podcast with Steve Gibson & Leo Laporte. Expert breakdowns of hacks, malware, ransomware, privacy tools, and network security strategies for professionals and everyday users.

Apple news podcast with Leo Laporte, Andy Ihnatko, Jason Snell & Christina Warren. In-depth analysis of iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro, iOS updates, Apple rumors, and expert advice for Apple enthusiasts.

Space news and astronomy podcast with Rod Pyle & Tariq Malik. Covering NASA missions, SpaceX launches, astrophysics discoveries, planetary science, and the future of human space exploration.

Be sure to check out other TWiT.tv podcasts for unique conversations about tech.
